description: A WorkSpec resource artifact: a single infrastructure node in a topology.

slug.description: Stable filename slug. Optional: the loader derives it from the artifact's filename under `.workspec/<kind-dir>/<slug>.yaml` when absent; when present it must already be a valid slug.

cost.description: This resource's cost binding, if it is priced.

attribution.description: Optional cost split across the c4 containers this resource realizes.

items.description: Attributes a share of a resource's cost to a c4 container.

container.description: The c4 container slug this share is attributed to.

share.description: Fraction of the resource cost attributed to this container.

qty.description: Unit count. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

sku.description: Ref to a decision catalog `skus[].id` this resource prices as.

environments.description: Subset of the owning Topology environments this resource is present in. Omitted means present in ALL of the topology environments — omission is meaningful and must not be defaulted to an explicit list.

items.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).

links.description: Cross-references to other artifacts or docs: exactly one {<linkType>: <pathRef>} pair per entry, plus an optional cardinality key ({from, to, label?}). Path refs must start with "~/" or "@workspace/".

propertyNames.description: The link type, e.g. "adr", "runbook" — or "cardinality" for the optional cardinality key.

network.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the vnet/subnet resource that places this resource in the network-lens view.

realizes.description: c4 container slugs this resource physically realizes.

resourceGroup.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the resource-group resource that places this resource in the resource-group-lens view.

source.description: Provenance: authored by hand or derived by a tool.

kind.description: Whether a human authored this resource or a tool derived it. Defaults to authored.

type.description: Vendor-specific display type, e.g. "Azure App Service".

title: WorkSpec Resource (v1alpha1)
